why.title: Why wetlands matter so much
why.subtitle: Climate regulators, biodiversity refuges, and water-security infrastructure
why.intro: Wetlands store carbon, purify water, buffer floods, and support countless species and human communities.

cards.title: Climate superheroes
cards.text: Mangroves and seagrass beds buffer storms and sea-level rise; peatlands cover only ~3% of land yet store about twice as much carbon as forests.

cards.title: Biodiversity refuges
cards.text: From migratory birds to fish and endemic amphibians, wetlands are among Earth’s richest ecosystems and vital refuges for threatened species.

cards.title: Water-security backbone
cards.text: Most freshwater flows through or from wetlands. They filter, store, and regulate water—balancing floods and droughts.
